result.topic_en: Scattered calculations on abelian integrals over a hyperelliptic curve given by a quadratic equation in s: the integrals z^{m-1}dz/sqrt(a_1^2 - a_0 a_2), the splitting of the radicand into products of linear factors (x-a)(x-b)... with characteristics, a genus count n = 2p + 2(μ-1), and binomial/theta-type counting formulas.
